what: Why the two R2b legs disagreed. The obvious hypothesis -- desk cost proportional to manual size -- is refuted in both directions: sk48 sent the SMALLER prompt (85,904 vs 128,759 chars), carried the SMALLER manual (32,522 vs 72,299), and paid 3.5x per action. Output tokens carry 69% of the bill on both legs, and four consecutive sk48 calls -- $14.93, 74% of the leg's spend -- returned replies with no === THEORY === block, so the books never moved and the leg never left step 10.
